title: Sprint G4 - rollup contract and aggregation
description: SPRINT BRIEF (phase 2). The global layer must never read N project state.json files directly - one stale or schema-drifted project would break the whole view, and full fan-out could not scale past a handful of repos. Contract: each project exports a small versioned rollup projection on every mutating command (status counts, limbo items, open blocking gaps, doctor and sync state, last event timestamp, top next directives, generatedAt); the global layer consumes only rollups; the daemon aggregates by watching linked project paths; without a daemon, bwrk global falls back to lazy fan-out with a TTL (the --live-cache-ttl-ms flag already exists on the global command). Honesty rule: every rollup carries generatedAt and every surface renders per-project staleness rather than pretending liveness - the same fail-closed honesty the runtime applies everywhere, applied upward.
